sara (sec-eng): quick Q — we got a vuln triage request that needs a SIEM export retained for 90d for vendor forensics. our default is 30d. can we approve 90d as an exception?
jamal (sec-infra): short: default 30d. exceptions ok but must be ticketed, KMS-wrapped, and timeboxed. we need justification recorded + automated TTL. link runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/siem-export-guidelines :point_right:
kevin (platform-security): who signs off on the RBAC change? analytics access often causes creep. note that granting a broad role will be denied.
lina (compliance): approval flow: open ticket with sensitivity tag + business justification + retention window. approvers: sec-eng lead + compliance. approval window is 72h; system issues a one-time justification token after approval. mark sensitivity as `restricted` if vendor is external.
sara (sec-eng): ok i'll file the ticket. operational question — how do we actually create a KMS-wrapped snapshot? any cli/example?
jamal (sec-infra): example flow (pre-scrub -> snapshot -> wrap):
```
# pre-scrub logs for PII
siem-export validate --project=acme --filter="incident:1234" --scrub=pii
# create snapshot with TTL and KMS key
siem-export create --project=acme --filter="incident:1234" --ttl=90d --kms-key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/siem/cryptoKeys/siem-exports --meta="ticket=INC-4521"
```
jamal (sec-infra): after creation the system writes audit rows: who requested, ticket id, justification token id, KMS unwrap events. we also require an HMAC of the snapshot stored in audit index.
oncall-bot: :package: Snapshot created: id=sn-20260321-0001 created_by=jamal meta=ticket=INC-4521 expires=90d kms_wrap=true audit_id=audit-7812
kevin (platform-security): +1 for 90d only if pre-export DLP scrub runs. add `--scrub=pii` and block exports that fail scrub. also limit analytic access to `siem-viewer-analytics` and timebox with `grant_ttl=14d` on the RBAC grant.
lina (compliance): add to runbook: required fields in ticket: severity, legal contact, vendor NDA status, retention justification, expected deletion date. we will auto-revoke grants at TTL and post deletion receipt to ticket.
sara (sec-eng): i'll open INC-4521 and cc @kevin. anything else? :thinking_face:
jamal (sec-infra): just one more: include an explicit mention if raw traces are needed. if so, require HSM-backed key (not just KMS) and 2-person unwrapping recorded in audit. otherwise scrubbed snapshots are fine.
kevin (platform-security): fine with that. please ensure RBAC change requests include the intended dataset IDs (no blanket perms).
sara (sec-eng): perfect, filing now. thanks all :thumbsup:
